subject.title: [Bug]: Chrome MCP existing-session `profile=user` reports ready but all page tools time out on macOS

question: Should this issue stay in maintainer-owned live reproduction until a current macOS Chrome 148+ trace proves whether the remaining timeout is OpenClaw wrapper code, upstream Chrome DevTools MCP, or an unsupported Chrome permission-gated attach state?
rationale: The source path is clear, but choosing a fix without macOS Chrome live evidence risks adding speculative wrapper behavior around an upstream MCP/browser boundary.

options.title: Reproduce and classify the boundary
options.body: Run the reported `status`, `tabs`, `snapshot`, `screenshot`, and `evaluate` flow on current macOS Chrome, capture Chrome MCP logs, then decide whether OpenClaw should repair the wrapper or document an unsupported state.

options.title: Document unsupported permission-gated attach
options.body: If live proof shows Chrome DevTools MCP cannot control that attach mode reliably, keep `pageReady` as the diagnostic and update Doctor/troubleshooting to steer users to managed, explicit endpoint, or extension-style alternatives.

options.title: Wait for upstream movement
options.body: If the failure is confirmed upstream-only and no OpenClaw mitigation is appropriate, keep the issue linked to upstream evidence and close only after a supported alternative or upstream fix is verified.

recommendation.title: Reproduce and classify the boundary
recommendation.body: Run the reported `status`, `tabs`, `snapshot`, `screenshot`, and `evaluate` flow on current macOS Chrome, capture Chrome MCP logs, then decide whether OpenClaw should repair the wrapper or document an unsupported state.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is currently assigned to `steipete`, who also appears in recent browser status/docs history around the partial `pageReady` fix.
